name: J. Hayes Moore
role: Rancher in the Killdeer Mountains country
bio: J. Hayes Moore had what the paper called a first-rate ranch in the Killdeer Mountains country in 1884. In October 1885 the Cow Boy reported his death from concussion of the brain after an accident, which recalled his mother, Lydia A. Moore, from Minneapolis.

moments.label: Death reported, from concussion of the brain

mentions: Hayes Moore is in from the Killdeer mountains country where he has a first-rate ranch. He expects to stay but a short time.
…s. Lydia A. Moore returned from Minneapolis Sunday night, whence she was recalled by the accident to her son, Hayes.
